headline: Route Mobile Q2FY27 Results: Net Profit Up 120% YoY
summary: Route Mobile reported a consolidated net profit of ₹82.55 crore for Q2FY27, up 120% YoY. Revenue rose 5.4% to ₹1,179.67 crore. Board declared ₹4 interim dividend.

headline: Quick Heal Q2FY27 PAT up 210% QoQ
summary: Quick Heal Technologies reported a profit after tax of ₹5.80 crore in Q2FY27, a 209.7% quarter-on-quarter rise. Revenue stood at ₹64.93 crore, down 22.3% YoY.
